1: First Year to Watch
As Vee arrives at Wilson Hall, she learns that performing arts boarding school might have more challenges than she thought. Demi vows to protect Vee from Van Helsings.
First Day of School
Vee's plans to have an amazing first day of school are threatened by a dire warning from the Vampire Council. Demi continues his search for Van Helsings.
First Dance
In the lead up to the Wilson Hall Welcome Dance, Vee and Elijah struggle with power imbalances. Meanwhile, Sophie searches for her DJ persona.
First Parents Day
When Parents Day sneaks up on Vee and Elijah, they struggle to keep their parents from meeting. Meanwhile, Demi learns how to disguise his ghostly form.
First Enemy
Vee and Sophie try to impress Elijah's sister Moriah, who invites the friends over for dinner. Meanwhile, Demi and Britney form an unlikely bond.
First Club
Vee, Sophie and Britney audition for "The Spotlights," an exclusive all-girls club at Wilson Hall. Meanwhile, Elijah and Demi try out being roommates.
First Halloween
Vee wishes on a Blood Moon to re-do Halloween with the help of a Moon Imp. Elijah helps Demi prove that he can still be scary in his "real boy" form.
First Nightmare
A visit from a gargoyle keeps Elijah from telling Vee a secret. Meanwhile, Sophie and Demi use a skeleton toy to help Elijah with a dance assignment.
First Final
When Vee asks for Demi's help on a class presentation, his ghostly secret is put in danger. Meanwhile, Elijah is invited to an underground rap cypher.
First Holiday
When Vee's at a loss for what to get her Secret Santa recipient, she enlists some Transylvanian help. Meanwhile, Elijah and Demi struggle to find the perfect gift for Sophie.
First Vampire Friend
When Vee's fritzing knocks out a fang, an unexpected chain of events draws her and Britney closer- just as Elijah and Sophie race to fix the situation.
First Heartbeat
Vee reconnects with Billie and gets a surprise visit from the Vampire Council. Meanwhile, Britney is mad at Elijah for forgetting their plans.
First Power Trip
Vee, Sophie, Elijah and Britney compete to be Millie Eyelash's opening act. Meanwhile, Demi is forced to protect Dean Merriweather.
First Pet
While Vee struggles to tell her friends her diagnosis, Sophie brings her pet bunny to school. Meanwhile, Demi and Britney invite Dean Merriweather to join their a cappella group.
First Villain
When Sophie directs Vee and Elijah in a romantic scene, a new student from Transylvania, Lucien, disrupts the chemistry. Meanwhile Demi and Britney have kitchen duties.
First Full Vampire
Lucien plots as Sophie, Elijah and Demi... reflect on their situation. Britney tries to meet Millie Eyelash and Vee learns a new way to channel her power.
